featured_reviews.review_text:
I want to begin by highlighting how incredible the yoga classes at this studio are - ‘Yoga se hoga by Drrashti’. She is exceptionally professional, always punctual, and truly consistent. She pays close attention to every single student, constantly correcting form and ensuring we practice safely. Over time, the yoga sessions have helped me physically feel stronger, more flexible, and much more balanced. I genuinely look forward to those classes and highly recommend them.

Unfortunately, my experience with the Reformer Pilates sessions was the complete opposite. I had booked a 12-session package, but classes were cancelled frequently and often at the last minute(sometimes after I reached the studio), making it impossible to maintain any routine or see progress. After finishing 9 sessions, I informed the instructor that I wanted to end the package early because of this inconsistency  and asked about a refund for the remaining 3 classes — but I never received a reply.

So while the studio and yoga instructor are outstanding, the inconsistency and lack of communication from the Pilates instructor were extremely disappointing.

The gym is clean and hygienic, the vibe is disciplined, and the natural light in the day lifts up your mood. If you want to be taught by some of the best in the business, with solutions tailored to your body and lifestyle, look no further.

featured_reviews.name: Prahlad Gaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
They say it’s not the fitness or training center, but it is your trainer / your fitness coach who largely contributes to your goals and success in your area of fitness.

Fortunately I got a chance to get trained under both the stalwarts Ignatius & Amol who run One More Fitness center today at Matunga.

Back in 2010 I underwent a surgery to correct my slipped disc at level 4 and 5 and after a year I signed up with Ignatius to work on my goal to strengthen my back. Ignatius trained me not only to achieve my goal but he also helped me build develop and strenghten my core muscles and improve my form. In a span of 3 months we saw great results -  my flexibility increased tremendously, I developed good balance and strength to work out various forms and heavy weights which I was cautious in begining. Thereafter I trained under Amol and Ignatius as per thier avaibilities and learnt a lot under them which today has helped me to workout independantly and put exercise into my daily routine.

Another great value I got was on the continuous improvisation of my workout routine and this was done as and when needed based on how my body responded to each form and routine.  These were the key differentiators which helped me build on and stick to a healthly lifestyle and this I miss seeing in most of the fitness centers today.

Thanks to Ignatius and Amol for creating awareness and training people to lead a fit and healthy lifestyle.

Good luck to them and Happy Training to You!

Because I had seen this gym somewhere around end of 2021-22, and this gym looked so lively and of positive vibes back then. And also had CrossFit area below the gym where now they have a restaurant. Now after the recent visit, I’m highly disappointed. Although gym is well maintained, good big changing room with mirror & lockers and also having all weight training equipment. All machines looked new & very beginners level. They had better machines earlier. Also there is no circuit training floor. No crossfit standalone rig. Such a big reputed gym no functional equipment like big truck tire, Sledgehammer, CrossFit standalone rig, battle rope. Having only cardio and weight machines is very common in every gym even in basic old gyms around . I was in Slimwell gym earlier , even they had all above mentioned stuff at just 10k year. This gym charges 20k-25k for just basic gym equipments. Which also I was ready to pay but where is the uniqueness and no CrossFit area. This was highly upsetting & disappointing. Big NO for now. Atleast deliver as per your gym rates. This gym looks 5/5 , but total waste and incomplete. It’s 2/5 now. All that glitters is not gold. You’ll have degraded your own gym standards. Upgrade smartly before it’s too late. Hope to join you’ll soon after upgradation.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Five Gardens area in Matunga is part of the famous Dadar-Parsi colony. This area was specially established for the upper class Parsis in the very early 19th century by the efforts of Mancherji Edalji Joshi, a renowned Parsi patron. The British however built it under the scheme of Bombay City Improvement Plan for the localities of Dadar, Matunga, Wadala, Sion in 1899-1900. So this is the first planned area of the city with spaces allocated for residences, green space, schools and colleges with proximity to transport infrastructure
The purpose was to de-congest the city after the Bombay Bubonic Plague Epidemic which broke in the September of 1896. According to the plan they wanted to house about 60,000 people in Sion and about 85,000 in Dadar & Matunga. Now there is as much people in every square kilometer of this area
So back to the garden itself. These are exactly five gardens just like shown in the map above. Getting here is quite simple. This is at a walking distance from King’s Circle and if you take the train get down at either Matunga or King’s Circle Railway Station and then take the taxi.
The garden itself is like any other Government infrastructure waiting to fall apart.
